title: Monitor Service State
description: Displays the current pipeline value in a scrolling log; passes data through unchanged. (Runtimes: browser, cpp; IDs: hookup.to/service/monitor, monitor)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

logToConsole.description: Print each value to the server's stdout

fileLogPath.description: Append each value to this file, inside the folders boards are given ([Filesystem](./filesystem.md#where-the-files-are)); a relative path is taken from the default one
